lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Circles, Angles, Area, and Surface Area
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: pi and circumference

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

items.prompt: A circle has a radius of 5 cm. What is its exact circumference?

steps: The diameter is twice the radius: 2 × 5 = 10 cm.
Circumference is π times the diameter: C = πd = 10π cm.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: A circle has a circumference of 40π in. What is its exact radius?
A circle has a diameter of 5 1/2 ft. What is its exact area? Express your answer as a multiple of π (use a fraction for the coefficient if it is not a whole number).

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A circle's radius equals its circumference divided by 2π. A circle has a circumference of 28π m. Use this relationship to find the circle's exact area, as a multiple of π.
Two angles are complementary. One angle measures 81°. What is the measure of the other angle?
Two lines intersect, forming vertical angles that measure (4x + 13)° and (6x - 9)°. Vertical angles are congruent. Find the value of x and the measure of the angles.
Two angles are supplementary. Their measures are (3x + 11)° and (4x + 120)°. Find the value of x and the measure of each angle.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: The angles around a point measure 40°, 230°, 33°, 20°, and x°. What is the value of x?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A figure is a 15-by-11 rectangle topped by a triangle. The triangle's base equals the rectangle's width, 15 units, and its height is 2 units. What is the total area of the figure, in square units?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
